_description: Edit the parameter values directly. Fields beginning with _description explain settings and do not affect calculations. Set input, order-reference and output paths at the top of main.py.
_description_schema_version: Configuration format version. Keep this at 1.

selection._description_ages_months: Age directories to process. For example, [8, 12] selects 8mo_data_pre and 12mo_data_pre.
selection._description_participants: An empty list selects all participants in the selected age directories. To select individuals, use complete IDs such as ["8mo_P001", "12mo_P001"].

_description_analyses: looking_time extracts whole-screen first/total looking time averaged across retained pairs; pair_looking_time also exports Pair 1 and Pair 2 separately using the same trial durations and metric-specific pair-retention rules. Selecting pair_looking_time automatically runs looking_time. Track ROI and proportion modules are deferred and cannot be selected in main.py.

rules._description_validation_start_ms: Inclusive validation-window start in milliseconds. 7000 means 7 seconds.
rules._description_validation_end_ms: Inclusive validation-window end in milliseconds. The validity denominator is the number of actually observed frames in this window.
rules._description_validation_threshold: Minimum cleaned looking-frame proportion required to pass validation. 0.5 means 50%; equality passes.
rules._description_measurement_start_ms: Inclusive looking-time measurement start in milliseconds. 13000 means 13 seconds.
rules._description_measurement_end_ms: null means no fixed upper cap: measure until the nonlooking rule triggers or the recording ends. A numeric value sets an inclusive timestamp cap in milliseconds.
rules._description_minimum_segment_ms: Historical state-switch confirmation and accepted looking-segment duration threshold in milliseconds. Short state changes may be bridged.
rules._description_terminate_nonlooking_ms: Continuous whole-screen nonlooking duration that stops total-looking measurement, in milliseconds. Delayed-termination auditing uses the observed trigger time of this rule.
rules._description_first_look_grace_ms: Historical first-look initial grace rule in milliseconds. Nonlooking onsets at or before measurement_start_ms plus this value use this termination threshold; later onsets use minimum_segment_ms.
rules._description_missing_gap_max_frames: Maximum missing-looking flag gap to repair when surrounded by looking: 0, 1 or 2 frames. Observed outside-ROI points are never repaired as missing. Measured pupil diameters and coordinates are not modified.

screen_roi._description: Whole-screen validity ROI in normalized screen coordinates, including display borders: top-left (0,0), bottom-right (1,1). All four boundaries are inclusive. Used for validation and whole-screen looking.
screen_roi._description_x_min: Left boundary of the whole-screen ROI.
screen_roi._description_x_max: Right boundary of the whole-screen ROI.
screen_roi._description_y_min: Top boundary of the whole-screen ROI.
screen_roi._description_y_max: Bottom boundary of the whole-screen ROI.

track_rois._description: Deferred track ROI settings, preserved for later work and not used by main.py. The retained spatial_roi.py module accumulates track dwell only within accepted whole-screen looking segments. Track switching does not terminate the trial. No separate 400 ms minimum track visit is applied.

left._description: Left track. The shared X=.5 edge belongs to the right track to avoid double counting.
left._description_x_min: Inclusive left boundary of the left track.
left._description_x_max: Right boundary of the left track; inclusion is controlled by x_max_inclusive.
left._description_y_min: Inclusive top boundary of the left track.
left._description_y_max: Inclusive bottom boundary of the left track.
left._description_x_max_inclusive: false excludes the right boundary; X=.5 is assigned to the right track.

right._description: Right track. Lower bounds and the upper Y bound are inclusive.
right._description_x_min: Inclusive left boundary of the right track.
right._description_x_max: Right boundary of the right track.
right._description_y_min: Inclusive top boundary of the right track.
right._description_y_max: Inclusive bottom boundary of the right track.

rules._description_test_pairs: Test1-2 form Pair 1 and Test3-4 form Pair 2. Only this design is supported. Both New and Old events must be valid; an incomplete first pair cannot be bypassed to use the second.
rules._description_condition_labels: Map Con/Int in inputs and the order reference to CON/INC output labels.
rules._description_proportion_denominators: Deferred proportion settings, preserved for later work and not used by main.py. roi_total divides ball/empty-location time by the sum of both track times; screen_total divides by accepted whole-screen total looking. Compute trial proportions before averaging the same event across complete valid pairs. Zero denominators yield missing proportions; true zero remains zero, log10(0) stays blank, and no pseudocount is added.
